title: agrostis pilosula var. alpestris
intro: Agrostis pilosula var. alpestris, commonly known as alpine bentgrass, is a plant species found in mountainous regions. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of alpine bentgrass include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Its bioactive constituents include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
